item.caption:
Happy Halloween! 👻 We’re only 3 days away from Election Day, and we’re still breaking down each ballot question for you all! Here’s Question 8: Repeal Current Marijuana Law.

Question 8 asks voters whether to repeal the existing law allowing recreational marijuana sales and use, and enforce penalties for possessing one to two ounces. A yes vote means recreational marijuana would no longer be legal to use or sell, with a $100 fine for anyone over 21 caught less than two ounces (but more than one ounce). A no vote means recreational marijuana remains legal to sell (from an established retailer) and use for those 21 and older.

Find all the ballot questions simplified using the link in our bio, and share with someone heading to the polls!

#BallotQuestions #ElectionDay

item.caption:
Election Day is Tuesday: Sample ballots are online for Cameron and Hidalgo county voters

Election Day for the Nov. 3, 2026 General and Special Elections is Tuesday. Polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., and voters who are in line by 7 p.m. can still cast a ballot.

The Cameron County Elections Department has sample ballots for the Nov. 3 elections available on its website. In both Cameron and Hidalgo counties, voters enter their name and date of birth to see the sample ballot for their precinct.

A sample ballot shows the federal, state and local races and propositions you will see when you vote. Check your county elections department website for your sample ballot and Election Day voting locations.

#ElectionDay #Vote2026 #CameronCounty #HidalgoCounty #RGV #956 #ValleyGroundNews
